messages:
jordan: Quick question — we need to finalize how quota tiers map when an API key is attached to an org or a billing account. Current naive rule is: use org.tier if key is scoped to an org, otherwise use api_key.tier. But billing just flagged cases where billing-account-level plans should override per-org tiers for enterprise contracts.
maya: Can you paste the exact mapping you're using today? Want to see the edgecases.
jordan: Sure, simplified pseudo logic:
```
# pseudo
if api_key.org_id:
  tier = org.tier
else:
  tier = api_key.tier
# burst allocation: org.burst_budget or api_key.burst_budget
```
liam: Heads up — billing treats some accounts as master plans (enterprise customers). They want quota/rate limits tied to billing_account.plan rather than individual orgs under the same billing account. If we keep current logic invoices and entitlements will diverge for those customers.
sophia: From product perspective we need per-org limits for team isolation, but we also need a billing-level guardrail for contract limits. Proposal: resolve in this order:
1) If billing_account.has_master_plan -> use billing plan (marked quota_scope=billing)
2) Else if org.tier exists -> use org.tier (quota_scope=org)
3) Else -> use api_key.tier (quota_scope=key)
And support an explicit org flag to opt-out of billing inheritance.
jordan: Edgecase: keys created pre-migration that later get attached to orgs. Do we migrate their remaining burst budget? I think we should clamp: new_allowance = min(current_remaining, new_tier_allowance) and emit an audit event. That avoids sudden blowouts.
maya: Ops requirements: we need to add telemetry fields so we can slice by scope. Suggest labels: quota_scope=(billing|org|key), quota_source_id, previous_tier. Also include tokens_charged_by_scope for billing reconciliation.
liam: Billing needs a mapping table: billable_unit -> (scope, multiplier). Example: tokens.user_generation -> billing_account if billing_scope else org. Without this we can't generate accurate invoices when a billing account spans multiple orgs.
sophia: Console UX: show a small callout on API key detail page: "This key's quotas are governed by Billing Account: ACME Corp (Enterprise Tier) — detach to apply org-level quotas." Also show a projected monthly overage if user detaches or attaches.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/quotas/plan-mapping -> staging at 21:00 UTC
jordan: Action items: maya -> add telemetry labels + telemetry PR; liam -> produce billing mapping table and confirm invoice delta scenarios; sophia -> mock console copy & CTA; i'll open the PR implementing the clamp-on-attach logic and the precedence rules.
maya: ack :thumbsup:
liam: I'll sync with finance on the mapping table, aim for tomorrow morning.
sophia: I'll drop mocks in #design-review by EOD and include copy variations.
jordan: Thanks everyone. Let's aim to have staging rollout and tests for back-compat migration behavior before we flip any prod flags."
